lines.speaker: The Raven
lines.text: You smell like someone who just came back from the dead. How refreshing.

lines.speaker: The Raven
lines.text: I've watched three hundred and twelve descents from this chain. You're not the worst.

lines.speaker: The Raven
lines.text: I won't tell you what killed you last time. You already know. You're just not ready to admit it.

lines.speaker: The Raven
lines.text: Something stirs on the deep floors. Not the usual bones and rot. Something older. I felt it.

lines.speaker: The Raven
lines.text: Go on then. I'll be here when you return. I'm always here when you return.
